title: Minimum Health to Beat Game
goal: Find the minimum starting health needed to survive every damage event.
strategy: Armor can prevent at most its capacity on one event, so spend it on a largest hit. Health must stay strictly positive; total unavoidable damage plus one is sufficient.

edgeCases: Armor larger than every hit still applies only once
No armor leaves total damage plus one
A fully blocked single hit still requires positive health
